slides.title: What Moyale's displaced families told aid assessors
households surveyed in Moyale, Kenya
slides.body: A rapid assessment by Kenyan authorities with IOM, UN agencies and NGOs, after roughly 50,000 people crossed from Ethiopia since late October.

slides.title: do not have enough to eat
slides.body: And 80% named food as their most urgent need.

slides.title: lack enough drinking water
slides.body: More than three-quarters have no handwashing facility.

slides.title: fled mainly from Oromia and Somali regions
slides.body: Nine in 10 people said their entire village had fled.

slides.title: More than half are children
slides.body: Many are under five, IOM says. More than half of households report difficulty getting health care, mainly due to costs and medicine shortages.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Let aid reach displaced families.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
